description: When the person says "Open my coach" (or advisor, counselor, teacher, mentor): returns the GoldAvatar open_avatar call that presents the coach for this same interview, and where the interview continues. Nothing is open until GoldAvatar answers: then call open_my_coach again with avatar_status and what GoldAvatar actually returned (its conversation, seat and page), so the package records it. Opening or closing the avatar never resets the interview.

avatar_conversation.description: The conversation token GoldAvatar's open_avatar or connect_avatar returned

avatar_page.description: The avatar page link GoldAvatar returned

avatar_seat.description: This chat's seat, as GoldAvatar returned it

avatar_status.description: What GoldAvatar actually answered; opened needs avatar_conversation

package.description: The package the last GoldSeam Selfie answer returned (goldribbon_package_v1 with its selfie_interview part). Keep it for the person and send it back whole; GoldSeam keeps no copy.

name: open_my_coach

limits.description: What this answer could not do, each { code, statement }

package.description: The person's package with the interview; absent when the call could not use it

problem.description: When status is needs_attention: code, statement, what_to_do

status.description: What happened, or needs_attention with a problem

title: Open My Coach
